name: input-otp-06
description: Controlled OTP input that mirrors the typed value and remaining digits below it.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, } from "@workspace/ui/components/input-otp" export default function ControlledOtpValueReadout() { const [value, setValue] = React.useState("") return (

{value.length === 0 ? "Enter the code we sent to hello@designali.com." : value.length < 6 ? "You entered " + value + " (" + (6 - value.length) + " left)" : "Code complete: " + value}

) }
